key_points: AI data-center pivot gaining validation: Amazon's potential $60B purchasing framework and die-to-die optical interconnect demo with Lumentum/Corning at ECOC 2026 mark meaningful diversification beyond handsets.
US-China trade de-escalation and Trump-Xi tech summit provided strong macro tailwind for chip stocks, boosting QCOM ~9% in a single session to multi-month highs.
Stock now trades ~10% above GF Value (~$175 vs ~$194), and analyst consensus is overwhelmingly neutral (23 holds vs 11 buys/outperforms), signaling limited near-term upside from current levels.
Google's push into premium laptops with Gemini represents a longer-term competitive risk to Qualcomm's Snapdragon X-series PC ambitions, though still early-stage.
CEO stock sale is under a preset 10b5-1 plan (low signal), and dividend news is routine; these are noise items that should not alter thesis.
